protocol.purpose: Measure the model-performance effect of per-game review caps using fixed algorithms and account-disjoint Kieran training.
protocol.training_source: Kieran Steam Reviews Kaggle version 2, all_reviews only; restore original archive and canonical identity shards
protocol.test_source: Forgemaster Kaggle version 1, clean unambiguous user/app pairs from completed full-corpus EDA
protocol.account_exclusions: Reserve every Forgemaster account eligible with full histories (395421) and all original Frank reserved accounts (87573). Remove all their Kieran histories before training. Also retain the original MD5 account-level 10% validation reservation, never used for fitting or model selection here.

models.name: binary_item_knn_k100
models.algorithm: Candidate-oriented binary positive cosine, top 100 input neighbors, singletons retained

models.name: activity_inverse_degree_cosine_k100
models.algorithm: Same candidate-oriented top 100, pair contribution and marginal weighted by reciprocal positive training user degree

models.name: metadata_extended_tfidf
models.algorithm: 0.5 cosine of unigram+bigram A-first/C-short description profiles plus 0.5 cosine of separate TF-IDF tag/genre/category/developer/publisher profiles; rebuilt from public metadata

models.name: train_popularity
models.algorithm: Training positive user support descending, App ID ascending ties; diagnostic control

protocol.eligibility: One hidden positive Linux game; after hiding, total catalog inputs >=5 and positive inputs >=1. Preserve empty recommendation lists in denominators.
protocol.target_selection: SHA256 counter-mode rejection-sampling uniform index over sorted positive Linux App IDs per exact account; one target per user. For paired comparisons, choose target from the capped history and use that SAME user and target for both full and capped query versions.
protocol.cap_method: Within the entire Forgemaster clean pair corpus, retain at most 100 user/app pairs per app ordered by hash(steamid,app_id,seed), exactly matching the completed EDA. Kieran training stays unchanged across all evaluations.
cohorts: Full: all 395421 eligible Forgemaster accounts, uncapped inputs, one uniformly hidden full-history target
Cap cohort full history: cap-eligible users and cap-selected targets, but full inputs and full observed-item exclusions
Cap cohort capped history with full exclusions: same users and targets, capped positive inputs and full observed-item exclusions (profile-only ablation)
Cap cohort capped history: same users and targets, capped inputs and capped observed-item exclusions (actual partial-history evaluation)
protocol.ranking: Positive finite scores only, top10, App ID ascending ties, mask all observed positive/negative inputs, restore hidden target, no fill; popularity control separately labeled
protocol.uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals for Recall; paired per-user bootstrap 2000 replicates, seed 20261108, for same-user/same-target Recall and NDCG differences. Five cap draws overlap; do not treat them as five independent populations.
protocol.selection: No hyperparameter search or model selection on Forgemaster outcomes; report all predeclared models.
protocol.interpretation: New account-disjoint retraining study; does not reproduce the missing historical Kieran model artifacts bit-for-bit. Tests within-source cap sensitivity, not Frank's exact API ordering or a chronological future-prediction scenario.

parameters.scoring: separate cosine of equal-weight positive-input mean profiles

interpretation: Conditional on this corpus and fixed algorithms. Different cap draws overlap; 5 draws are not independent populations. Paired bootstrap is per user within one draw.
